calls.title: LinkedIn: shadowing + mass video
calls.summary: The discussion centered on improving LinkedIn outreach by shifting to Sales Navigator for better campaign tracking and efficiency. Jake noted the addition of 78 leads since last Wednesday, enabling tailored messaging and daily reviews. The team highlighted a response rate of 5-20%, noting challenges with follow-ups due to interface limitations, while stressing shorter, casual messages and video outreach for better engagement. Strategic insights from conversations revealed pain points in homegrown solutions, informing future targeting strategies. Matthew emphasized realistic time management, estimating 4-6 hours for outreach work daily, and underscored the importance of integrating automated systems to streamline processes and improve lead quality.
calls.keywords: LinkedIn outreach, Sales Navigator, Referral processing, Prospect engagement, Campaign tracking, Video messaging
